articles.title: The Doctors Who 'Don’t See Pregnant Patients'
articles.excerpt: (MedPage Today) -- The resident was apologetic over the phone, embarrassed for reasons outside his control. He was transferring, from his hospital to ours, a pregnant patient who required consultation for a non-obstetric illness. This alone was...
articles.summary: 文章讲述一位住院医师为一名需要非产科疾病会诊的孕妇转诊，并评论某些医生拒绝接诊孕妇的现象。
